items.title: Recruitment
items.text: Candidates from Ukraine, Georgia, Asia and South America, verified for qualifications and residence status.

items.title: Work permits
items.text: Declarations at the labour office, type A permits, starost information — full paperwork and deadlines on our side.

items.title: Residence card

items.title: Staff leasing
items.text: We employ the workers and second them to you. You plan the shifts, we run HR.

items.title: Housing and transport
items.text: Accommodation close to the plant and shift transport on a single invoice.

items.title: Advisory and inspections
items.text: Notification duties, documentation ready for Labour Inspectorate and Border Guard checks, reminders when the office is silent.

legal.title: Legalisation is our job, not your problem

points.title: One case manager
points.text: The same person from enquiry to residence card collection. The same phone number.

points.title: We watch the office deadlines
points.text: When a case stalls, we file a reminder. You work, we write to the voivode.

points.title: Residence card with guarantee
points.text: A service option in which we run the case through to the issue of the residence card on the terms set out in the contract. Ask about the conditions in the chat.

points.title: Five languages of support
points.text: Polish, English, Ukrainian, Russian and Spanish — in conversation and in documents.

items.title: New processing deadlines for temporary residence applications — what the act changes
items.excerpt: Parliament has set new deadlines for voivodes. We check who they cover and what to do when a case is already pending.

items.title: The Labour Inspectorate can establish an employment relationship by decision. What it means for contracts with foreigners
items.excerpt: After the amendment, a labour inspector can turn a civil contract into employment by decision. We explain the consequences for companies employing foreigners.

items.title: Changing employer with a residence card: when a permit change is required
items.excerpt: A new employer does not always mean a new application. We explain when a notification is enough and when the permit must be changed.
